'''2026 Retro Worlds Jeremy Christoffel DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy Christoffel]] at the [[2026 Retro World Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeremy Christoffel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Retro World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26RWC Christoffel DS SYCFA.txt |Download]]
